map.磁罗经自差校正计算：真航向、磁航向、罗航向之间的换算与自差表生成: Magnetic compass deviation correction: conversion between true heading, magnetic heading and compass heading, plus deviation table generation
map.「磁罗经自差校正计算：真航向、磁航向、罗航向之间的换算与自差表生成」按输入参数进: Computes magnetic compass deviation correction, the conversion between true heading, magnetic heading and compass heading, and the generation of the deviation table from the inputs, then outputs the result.
map.📖 查看「磁罗经校正 使用指南」: 📖 View the guide to magnetic compass correction
map.航行推算时，在罗航向(CH)、磁航向(MH)、真航向(TH)之间按磁差(Var): In dead reckoning, convert between compass heading (CH), magnetic heading (MH) and true heading (TH) using variation (Var) and deviation (Dev), to meet passage planning and collision avoidance needs.
map.罗经自检或新装罗经后，用五系数法（A/B/C/D/E）绘制自差表，量化各罗经向位: After a compass self-check or a newly installed compass, use the five-coefficient method (A/B/C/D/E) to draw up a deviation table and quantify the deviation correction for each compass heading.
map.海图作业或 GPS 偏置比对时，将罗经读数修正为真北基准，消除罗经差（Dev+V: When working on charts or comparing GPS offsets, correct the compass reading to a true north basis to remove the heading error caused by compass error (Dev + Var).
map.罗航向求真航向示例: Example: finding the true heading from the compass heading
map.某海区磁差 Var = 5°E、自差 Dev = 3°E，罗航向 CH = 09: In an area with variation Var = 5°E and deviation Dev = 3°E, with compass heading CH = 090°, find the true heading. Compass error = Dev + Var = 3 + 5 = 8°E; magnetic heading MH = 090 + 3 = 093°; true heading TH = 093 + 5 = 098°. In reverse (true to compass), subtract the corrections in turn: CH = TH − Var − Dev.
map.磁差和自差有什么区别？: What is the difference between variation and deviation?
map.磁差 Var 是地磁北与真北的夹角（随海区与年变），自差 Dev 是船体磁材对罗: Variation is the angle between magnetic north and true north (it changes by area and by year), while deviation is the interference of the ship’s magnetic materials with the compass (it changes with the ship’s heading); compass error = Dev + Var is the total difference between the compass reading and true north. At sea, looking up the deviation table by the ship’s heading and applying the correction cancels it out.
map.自差表（五系数）怎么用？: How is the five-coefficient deviation table used?
map.自差 Dev = A + B·sin(CH) + C·cos(CH) + D·s: Deviation Dev = A + B·sin(CH) + C·cos(CH) + D·sin(2CH) + E·cos(2CH), with the coefficients fitted from measured compass headings. Each compass heading CH in the table has a matching correction; at sea, look up the value for the current heading, add or subtract it to get the magnetic heading, then add the variation to get the true heading.
